Interface Repository<ID, E extends HasId<ID>>

Type Parameters:
ID - the identifier type
E - the entity type exposing that identifier
All Known Subinterfaces:
FriendshipRepository, UserRepository
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractFileRepository, FriendshipDbRepository, FriendshipFileRepository, InMemoryFriendshipRepository, InMemoryRepository, InMemoryUserRepository, UserDbRepository, UserFileRepository
public interface Repository<ID, E extends HasId<ID>>
Provides access to entities by identifier. Validation, null handling and persistence depend on the implementation; see its operation documentation. Database placeholders may reject every operation as unsupported.

  • Method Details

    • findOne

      Optional<E> findOne(ID id)
      Looks up an entity by identifier.
      Parameters:
      id - the identifier; null handling is implementation-specific
      Returns:
      the matching entity, or an empty optional when absent
      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - if lookup is not implemented

    • findAll

      Iterable<E> findAll()
      Retrieves the entities currently available to this repository.
      Returns:
      an iterable of entities, empty when none exist; ordering and mutability depend on the implementation
      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - if retrieval is not implemented

    • save

      void save(E entity)
      Inserts an entity without replacing an existing entity with the same ID.
      Parameters:
      entity - the entity to insert; acceptance rules depend on the implementation
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the entity is rejected by repository argument checks or its identifier is already stored
      ValidationException - if an installed validator rejects the entity
      RepositoryException - if persistence fails
      UnsupportedOperationException - if insertion is not implemented

    • delete

      void delete(ID id)
      Removes the entity with the supplied identifier.
      Parameters:
      id - the identifier to remove; null handling is implementation-specific
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no entity has that identifier
      RepositoryException - if persistence fails
      UnsupportedOperationException - if deletion is not implemented

    • update

      void update(E entity)
      Replaces the stored entity with the same identifier.
      Parameters:
      entity - the replacement; acceptance rules depend on the implementation
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if id is null or no entity has that identifier
      ValidationException - if an installed validator rejects the entity
      RepositoryException - if persistence fails
      UnsupportedOperationException - if replacement is not implemented
